request: Update the default development build after the user saved/closed it, and synchronize the approved accumulated workspace changes to GitHub.

git.strategy: Commit the reviewed workspace changes, then normal fast-forward push to origin/main. Never force-push, reset, or move the existing release tag.
git.receiptRule: The exact resulting commit and independent remote/clean-worktree checks are recorded after pushing in the evidence root. This tracked handoff does not attempt to embed its own future commit hash or claim cross-platform CI has completed.

scope: Matrix-style multi-configuration editor, same-row Lens Data controls and bold column headers.
Previously completed but uncommitted source repairs: observed localization/search, recovery path protection, exact frozen native replay fixtures and the initial-model optimizer safeguard.
Previously completed workspace dock guidance, full-height sidebar boundary, responsive analysis plots, README acknowledgments, maintained guides and scoped validation ledgers.
CI partition scheduling and formatting already covered by the earlier repair ledger; preserve the original long-survey cases, budgets, optical assertions and frozen references.
countingRule: Related rendering and regression cases overlap and must not be added; prior-stage checks retain their own timestamps and scope. Source synchronization does not make the previously uploaded installer contain these newer UI changes.
